annotations.title: One cell of an EU table

description: ONE CELL of an EU table, by its id (printed by read_eu_table and search_eu_tables) or by table, row and column: its text, its whole row under the column names, the rows above and below, the cells to its left and right, its table and its act. Ids change when an act is parsed again: search again rather than reuse an old id.

cell.description: The id of the cell, e.g. '268478774'.

column.description: With `table` and `row`: the column, by name or number.

row.description: With `table`: the row number as the answers print it.

table.description: The table, as list_eu_tables or search_eu_tables printed it: 'tabel-ue:176080512.2' (or just 176080512 when the node holds one table).

name: get_eu_cell
